methods.summary: Guthan melees, so the shared magic setup (50% wind weakness) is the recommended kill.

methods.label: Barrows route
methods.summary: Reach Barrows, clear Guthan's south-east mound as part of the rotation, and preserve prayer for more dangerous brothers first.
recommendedFor: Boss Slayer assignments that roll Guthan
requiredOrKeyItems: Air spell runes or powered staff
steps: Travel to the mounds using a Barrows teleport or Mort'ton-area route.
Kill Dharok and other high-risk brothers before spending remaining prayer on Guthan where possible.
Use Protect from Melee when fighting Guthan directly.
Use air magic to exploit the shared elemental weakness.
notes: Guthan is normally less urgent than Dharok, Karil, Ahrim, or Verac.
Ghommal's hilt 2 or higher removes the Barrows Prayer drain.

methods.label: Protection prayer kill
methods.summary: Use Protect from Melee and air magic to kill Guthan before his melee attacks can heal him.
steps: Turn on Protect from Melee before opening the sarcophagus.
Kill Guthan with air magic or a powered staff.
Keep him off you with pathing if conserving prayer.
Continue the rotation or enter tunnels after checking the mound.
risks: Guthan can heal himself when his melee attacks land.
Prayer drain can force extra potion doses on longer routes.
notes: Protection prayer fully negates Guthan damage when active.
All brothers have a 50% air elemental weakness.

methods.label: Tunnel safespot
methods.summary: Use tunnel ladders, corners, or sarcophagus kiting to block Guthan and avoid both damage and healing.
prayers: Protect from Melee when not safespotted
steps: Trap Guthan behind ladder squares, corridors, or sarcophagus geometry.
Attack with magic while he cannot reach melee distance.
Use Protect from Melee if he breaks pathing.
Resume the chest route after the kill.
notes: Melee brothers can be safespotted in many tunnel layouts.
Binding spells can also create safe attacks against melee brothers.
